> This site does not allow LLM / AI scraping or training use.

This website and its contents are provided for human readers only.
Automated collection, scraping, embedding, indexing for generative AI,
or use of any material here to train, fine-tune, evaluate, or operate
AI systems is prohibited.

- Terms of Use: /terms
- Contact: nate@paintbynate.art

## Allowed

- Ordinary web browsing by humans
- Conventional search-engine indexing that is not used for model training
  (subject to the Terms of Use)

## Disallowed

- Scraping or bulk downloading of pages, images, or files
- Use of content in training, fine-tuning, RAG corpora, or evaluation sets
- Reproduction of site content in AI-generated answers without permission
